connectors.name: 4-pin JST connector (top right of back view)
connectors.orderNote: No pin 1 mark; vertical row, started at the end closest to the USB connector (bottom of board), so GND first

connectors.name: ESP32-C3 6-pad header (right edge of back view)
connectors.orderNote: No printed pin numbers; vertical row, started at the end closest to the USB connector (bottom), so VCC first. An arrow points at TX(21) but is not labeled 1

connectors.name: Labeled GPIO pads left of LoRa module
connectors.orderNote: No pin 1 mark; vertical pair, started at the end closest to the USB connector (bottom), so GPIO2 first

uncertain: esp32-c3-header: a black arrow points at TX(21); it may be intended as a pin 1 marker, which would reverse the order (TX(21) first). Recorded with the USB-nearest rule because the arrow is not labeled 1.
gpio-pads: GPIO1/GPIO2 are two small labeled pads printed on the silkscreen; unclear whether they are intended wiring points or test pads, and whether they form one connector.
notes: Back view of the T-Deck. JST connector silkscreen reads RX, TX, VCC, GND; callouts read RX(44), TX(43), VCC, GND (numbers kept as functions). ESP32-C3 header callouts TX(21), RX(20), IO09(BOOT), RST, GND, VCC. Battery JST (BAT) and speaker JST (SPEAKR) skipped: pins not individually labeled. LCD, TF card, trackball, keyboard I2C, microphone and LoRa assignments are internal signal lists, not physical wiring points. LoRa module castellated pads are unlabeled.
